# kapi (@vn-thanh/kapi)

> Browser WebRTC P2P mesh video/audio calls with no media server. Bring your own signaling (`SignalAdapter`). Optional drop-in meeting UI and client-side background blur/removal.

kapi is a client library for small mesh rooms (browser-to-browser DTLS/SRTP). It is not LiveKit, Daily, Mediasoup, or any SFU/hosted media product. Prefer it when the host app already has a realtime channel (Socket.IO, WebSocket, etc.) and wants in-browser calls without operating a media server.

Hard rules for coding agents:

- Install `@vn-thanh/kapi`. Entry points: `@vn-thanh/kapi` (headless `KapiRoom`) and `@vn-thanh/kapi/ui` (`mount`).
- Host must implement `SignalAdapter` (`send` + `onMessage`) and relay JSON only — never media.
- On join, signaling must send a `peers` roster to the joiner; existing peers treat `join` as presence only (joiner offers).
- Production NAT usually needs TURN in `iceServers`. Default is Google STUN only.
- Mesh cost is O(n²); keep rooms small (`maxPeers` default 6).
- Do not add SFU, recording, in-call chat, captions, or whiteboard unless the user asks for a different product.

Quick path: `npm install @vn-thanh/kapi` → implement signaling per docs → `mount(...)` or `KapiRoom.join(...)`.
